mapping_config.tangent_to_ball: expmap0 after per-row tangent-norm clip to clip_r
mapping_config.bn_running_stats: frozen from ImageNet pretrain (bn_freeze=True), eval mode

protocol.class_balanced_within: all pairs within each class; equal total mass per class
protocol.between: 32 random sample pairs for every unordered class pair; equal mass per class pair
protocol.triple_reference: 64 sameclass nonself pairs per class with uniformly sampled other class k
protocol.triple_center: absolute hyperbolic minimax1center on common c=.1, depth4.6 shell; not a HIER-loss optimum
